title: Fixing login password errors
content:
# Fixing login password errors

**Applies to:** Console

## Symptoms

- login rejected with invalid password
- locked account banner

## Common causes

- too many failed password attempts

## Resolution

1. wait thirty minutes for the lock to clear
2. clear browser cookies

## Notes

Repeated lockouts suggest an automated script.

title: Understanding your invoice
content:
# Understanding your invoice

**Applies to:** All plans

## Symptoms

- invoice total higher than expected

## Common causes

- usage overage charges this month

## Resolution

1. open the usage breakdown page
2. compare billing period usage

## Notes

Invoices close at month end.

title: Webhook delivery retries
content:
# Webhook delivery retries

**Applies to:** All plans

## Symptoms

- webhook events not delivered
- duplicate webhook deliveries

## Common causes

- endpoint returned an error status

## Resolution

1. return a 2xx status quickly
2. make handlers idempotent

## Notes

Retries use exponential backoff.
